public_rlm.label: Reverse Line Move
public_rlm.explain: Most of the money and most of the tickets are on one side, yet the line moved the other way.

research.label: Sharp Split
research.explain: Most tickets are on one side, but most of the money is on the other, and the line moved with the money.

research.label: Steam
research.explain: The line moved toward the side with the big money, even though most tickets are on the other side.

research.label: Split Move
research.explain: Most of the money is on one side and most tickets on the other, and the line moved against the money.

sharp_record.basis: Tracked moves only (measured from the first DraftKings line we saw). 1 unit at -110 at the DraftKings line when flagged.

rlm_watch.rule: Reverse line move (RLM): 60%+ of the DraftKings money AND 50%+ of the tickets on one side, yet the DraftKings line moved 0.5+ points in that side's favor, measured from the first DraftKings line we saw and confirmed by two DraftKings pulls in a row. All numbers DraftKings.
rlm_watch.tracker_note: Tracking record: fading the public side of every RLM (0.5+ pts open to close) at the DraftKings closing line, 1 unit flat. Not our picks; small sample.
